results.title: The Impact of Modern AI in Metadata Management
results.content: As metadata evolves, it continues to play a pivotal role in shaping AI-driven innovations, improving data governance, and enhancing the value of audiovisual and other resources [4:1–5."), 5:1477–94.")]. AI technologies, such as natural language processing (NLP) and unsupervised learning, further enhance metadata generation and maintenance by automating the extraction of relevant information and addressing challenges like data quality and governance [1:e25440."), 8:1–36.")]. Current literature highlights AI’s role in healthcare and information systems but provides limited insights into metadata management practices [9:7082."), 10:1–18.")]. By addressing practical issues like metadata reuse and lifecycle management, this study seeks to provide actionable AI-driven solutions and lay the groundwork for next-generation metadata management systems [13, 14:20–6.")]. The contribution focuses on how the solution will improve metadata handling, enhance data quality, and impact the management of future datasets. Optimizing data governance through AI-driven metadata management: enhancing data discovery and utilization in organizations _._ Innovat Eng Sci J. a study of blockchain-based metadata management and its use for data verification.
